englishOverrides.Enterprise.employee.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, employee ID, email, phone, or initials in Pinyin...
englishOverrides.Enterprise.employee.confirmBulkDesc: This lists all active employees who do not yet have an account and provisions them in batches, not limited by the current page size. Progress is shown here. About {count} active employees currently have no account; those who already have one are skipped automatically.
englishOverrides.Enterprise.employee.confirmBatchGenerate: Employees who already have an account are skipped automatically; only those not yet provisioned are processed. Provisioning is submitted in small batches so you can see progress in this dialog.
englishOverrides.SwapMid:System:DataDictionaryItemReorder: The submitted item list is not a complete permutation of this dictionary
englishOverrides.System.dataDictionaries.itemsDialog.dial: Leave blank to use the display text
If left blank, this defaults to the display text and usually does not need editing
New items get the next number automatically. You can also drag rows to reorder.
englishOverrides.System.scheduledJobs.toastRunSkippedDesc: Another run is already in progress; this run was not repeated.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.common.recoveryStorageUn: Local execution protection was not established

Local execution protection could not be established because recovery storage is unavailable or invalid, its safety limit was reached, or another RunId is already present. No execution or reconciliation was started. Keep this page open and contact an administrator.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.common.recoveryCleanupUn: The server-side result is definitive, but local execution protection could not be cleared. The original RunId was retained for read-only verification after recovery becomes available. Refresh the page; if this continues, contact an administrator.

englishOverrides.Login.errorPasswordComplexity: The new password does not meet the current rules

englishOverrides.Account.user.removeOption: Remove — take the selected roles off each account and keep the rest
englishOverrides.Account.user.clearOption: Clear — remove every role from the selected accounts
englishOverrides.Account.user.removeHint: Only the roles selected above are removed. Other roles on each account stay.
englishOverrides.Account.user.clearHint: Every role on the selected accounts will be removed, including administrator. You can assign roles again afterwards.
englishOverrides.Account.user.roleFilterMatchHint: Shows accounts that have any of the selected roles
englishOverrides.Account.permission.exportUnsavedHint: The file is the saved grants. Selections on this page that have not been saved are not written into the file.
englishOverrides.Account.permission.exportContentsHint: Effective permissions include only people who can still sign in: the account is enabled, and the employee is active or not linked. Disabled, resigned, and suspended people stay on the people-and-roles sheet. Administrator permissions are on their own sheet.
englishOverrides.SwapMid:ACC:001: This role assignment method is not supported.
englishOverrides.SwapMid:ACC:002: Select at least one role to append.
englishOverrides.SwapMid:ACC:003: Select at least one role to remove. To remove every role, use clear.
englishOverrides.SwapMid:ETL:036: Upstream table schema drift detected; guardrail paused or blocked capture: {Reason}
englishOverrides.DeveloperDocs.apiReference.designPrincip: Core principles guiding API development and evolution, helping developers quickly understand and integrate with the SwapMid API.
englishOverrides.Common.savedViewsLimitHint: Save up to {max} view presets per table
englishOverrides.Sidebar.filterDomainItems: Filter items in this domain (supports Pinyin initials)
englishOverrides.Sidebar.noItemMatch: No matching items in this domain
englishOverrides.Account.permission.revokeDeleteDescripti: Unchecks all {count} granted delete permissions across every module for role “{role}” while keeping other permissions intact, regardless of current search filters. Click Save to apply. Permissions inherited from other roles or direct user grants are unaffected.
englishOverrides.Account.permission.exportScopeHint: Exports saved permissions across all roles together with the user-and-role matrix, not only the currently selected role.
englishOverrides.Account.permission.basePermissionHint: Base permission controls access to the resource; unsplit maintenance operations may also depend on it.
englishOverrides.Account.permission.noChildActions: No child actions match the current filter. Some resources do not split action permissions yet—check the base permission description.
englishOverrides.Account.permission.roleLoadFailed: Failed to load roles. Please try again.
englishOverrides.Account.permission.scopeHint: {count} matched; bulk toggle applies only to matched items while parent-child dependencies stay linked
englishOverrides.Account.permission.emptyPermissions: No configurable permissions for this role
englishOverrides.Account.permission.dependencyHint: Granting a child permission automatically grants its parent; revoking a parent revokes all its children.
englishOverrides.Account.permission.discardHint: Role “{role}” has {count} unsaved changes. Continuing will discard them.
englishOverrides.Account.permission.reviewHint: About to save {count} permission changes for role “{role}”. Please verify the scope; affected users must sign in again after saving.
englishOverrides.Account.permission.opsConfirmDescription: This change includes operations-level permissions that are typically unnecessary for business roles. Please confirm the intended scope and impact.
englishOverrides.Account.permission.opsAcknowledge: I have reviewed the operations permission scope and confirm granting it
englishOverrides.Account.permission.concurrentChangeHint: Saved permissions for this role were modified elsewhere. Your draft is preserved—close this preview, reload, and review again.
englishOverrides.Account.permission.compareSavedHint: Compares saved direct grants between the two roles; excludes inherited or per-user grants.
englishOverrides.Account.permission.compareUnsavedHint: The current role has unsaved edits; comparison below reflects saved permissions only. Save and reopen to view updated diffs.
englishOverrides.Account.permission.draftFound: An unsaved permission draft from this session was found. Restore it to continue editing, or discard it.
englishOverrides.Account.permission.draftStale: A permission draft was found, but the saved grants have changed since then. Discard the stale draft and reconfigure to avoid overwriting concurrent updates.
englishOverrides.Account.permission.draftUnavailable: Browser draft storage is unavailable. Save your changes before switching tabs or leaving.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.pipeline.writeModeUpsert: Incremental merge + Target Receipt (PostgreSQL / SQL Server)
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.pipeline.receiptTargetUn: Target Receipt requires a PostgreSQL or SQL Server target with strict TLS enabled. Fix the target data source first instead of downgrading the pipeline to plain writes.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.pipeline.upsertConfigInv: Upsert requires at least one valid, unique business key column; if a watermark column is specified, it cannot overlap the key columns.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.pipeline.upsertModeHint: Target key columns must be NOT NULL and backed by a primary key or unique index; staging null and duplicate keys are rejected before target commit.
englishOverrides.ApiManagement.clients.pageDescription: Client credentials, ACLs, and rate limits for the API Gateway
englishOverrides.ApiManagement.clients.issueHint: Issues a client_id and client_secret granted the external-integration scope.
englishOverrides.ApiManagement.clients.usageStep1: 1. POST /connect/token (grant_type=client_credentials, scope=external-integration) to obtain an access_token
englishOverrides.ApiManagement.clients.policyDialogDescri: Configure the per-minute rate limit and allowed API route groups for client “{clientId}”.
englishOverrides.ApiManagement.clients.policyRatePlacehol: Leave blank to use platform default (120 req/min)
englishOverrides.ApiManagement.clients.policyRateHint: Integer between 1 and 60000; excess requests receive 429 Too Many Requests with Retry-After.
englishOverrides.ApiManagement.clients.policyRateInvalid: Enter an integer between 1 and 60000, or leave blank for the default quota
englishOverrides.ApiManagement.clients.policyGroupsHint: Leave all unchecked to allow any enabled route group; check specific groups to restrict access.
englishOverrides.ApiManagement.clients.policyGroupsEmptyH: No API route groups exist yet; enabled routes are allowed by default.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.pipeline.preflightSelect: Select a data source and enter a source SELECT query first
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.pipeline.preflightNoIssu: Source projection, target schema, key constraints, and write mode checks all passed.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.pipeline.preflightFailed: Schema pre-flight request failed; check network connectivity or permissions
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.pipeline.mapperImplicitH: When no explicit mapping is set, columns align by exact name; click Auto Match or select per column below.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.pipeline.mapperPreflight: Explicit field mappings configured; run Schema Pre-flight to load columns for interactive editing.
englishOverrides.Login.ssoErrorInvalidState: Enterprise SSO verification state expired or was invalid; please try again
englishOverrides.Login.ssoErrorExchangeFailed: External identity verification failed, or your platform account is not enabled
englishOverrides.Login.ssoErrorSessionFailed: Failed to establish a platform session; please try again later or contact an administrator
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.source.optionalPasswordP: Leave blank if none, or enter password
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.source.secretPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep current secret
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.pipeline.etlSectionHint: Runs the read-only SELECT query on the source and delivers batches to a relational table, ClickHouse, Kafka topic, or object storage sink.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.pipeline.destinationInva: Destination name contains invalid characters or path segments; provide a valid table name, Kafka topic, or object prefix.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.pipeline.writeModeTarget: Selected target does not support this write mode: ClickHouse supports append / truncate; Kafka and Object Storage support append only.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.pipeline.schemaOnWriteSi: Streaming and object storage sinks deliver projected schema-on-write columns; use Schema Pre-flight or Field Mappings below to project and rename columns.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.pipeline.statusTransitio: Status update failed. Verify data source connectivity and schema pre-flight configuration.
englishOverrides.SwapMid:ETL:030: PostgreSQL CDC stream definition not found.
englishOverrides.SwapMid:ETL:031: A CDC stream with this name already exists.
englishOverrides.SwapMid:ETL:033: Only Active CDC streams can run background capture; please activate it first.
englishOverrides.SwapMid:ETL:034: WAL capture is already running for this CDC stream; please try again shortly.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.deleteDesc: Permanently delete CDC stream "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.sourceEmptyText: No CDC-capable data source found (PostgreSQL / SQL Server)
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.monitoredTablesHint: Use schema.table format separated by commas; leave blank to use an existing Publication.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.autoCreateHint: Creates the logical replication objects automatically during preflight or activation when missing.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.targetSinkDestHint: Use Topic for Kafka, database.table for ClickHouse, or directory prefix for Object Storage.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.initialSnapshotSwitc: Run Consistent Initial Snapshot Before Streaming
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.initialSnapshotHint: Exports a repeatable-read snapshot at slot creation (PG EXPORT_SNAPSHOT) before streaming subsequent WAL changes.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.targetSinkKeyColumns: Comma-separated column names (e.g. order_id or customer_id,order_id) used for Kafka partition keys, ClickHouse ORDER BY suggestions, and ObjectStorage metadata.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.preflightFailedFallb: Could not connect to PostgreSQL or verify logical replication readiness.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.lifecycleFailedFallb: Status change failed; verify source logical replication preconditions.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.captureFailedFallbac: Failed while capturing pgoutput WAL changes or delivering downstream.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.checkpointFailedFall: Failed to reset checkpoint; verify the LSN format (e.g. 0/16B6C50).
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.dropSlotFailedFallba: Failed to drop slot; ensure the stream is paused and slot is idle.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.checkpointDialogDesc: Enter a valid PostgreSQL LSN (e.g. 0/16B6C50) or leave blank to clear the saved checkpoint.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.checkpointInputHint: Hex high/low offset such as 0/16B6C50; leave blank to clear stored LSN.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.dropSlotDialogDesc: Drops upstream PostgreSQL slot "{slot}" and clears local checkpoint on "{name}" to release retained WAL.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.sinkTemplateFailedFa: Could not build external sink schema or DDL template.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.snapshotFailedFallba: Could not run PostgreSQL consistent initial snapshot.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.snapshotSuccessDesc: Exported {rows} rows ({delivered} delivered) at consistent LSN {lsn}
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.provisionClickHouseF: Check ClickHouse credentials, network allowlist, and CREATE TABLE privilege.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.targetRelationalTabl: Use schema.table (e.g. public.etl_demo_orders_mirror); exactly one monitored source table is required and target must have a PK or unique index on key columns.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.softDeleteColumnHint: Boolean or integer column (e.g. is_deleted); set true/1 on delete, false/0 on reinsert.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.softDeleteTimestampC: Optional nullable timestamp/text column (e.g. deleted_at_utc); cleared to NULL when active.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.mirrorMapperDefaultH: Leave empty to pass matching column names automatically; click Inspect to remap or filter columns.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.mirrorInspectFailedF: Failed to inspect source or target mirror table columns; verify connectivity and table names.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.acceptSchemaFailedFa: Could not inspect upstream monitored table schema or save baseline.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.sourceTypeSqlServerH: Captures committed deltas via CHANGETABLE(CHANGES ...) for tracked tables with primary keys; no Publication or Slot needed.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.monitoredTablesSqlSe: SQL Server requires at least one tracked table with a primary key, e.g. dbo.orders.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.lakehouseCompactMinF: ObjectStorage (Parquet/JSONL) only; automatically merges small fragments once recent uncompacted file count reaches this threshold.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.compactLakehouseFail: Could not read or merge ObjectStorage fragments; verify endpoint allowlist and credentials.
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.source.schemaRegistryUrl: Connect to Confluent / Redpanda Schema Registry to decode binary Avro Debezium events
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.lakehouseWriteModeHi: Merge-on-Read requires key columns and emits Equality Delete files for deduplicated reads
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.gitOpsDialogDesc: Export secret-free YAML/JSON manifests, diff changes across environments, and safely apply
englishOverrides.DataIntegration.cdc.gitOpsBundlePlacehol: Click Export to load the current environment bundle, or paste a swapmid.io/v1 YAML/JSON manifest to diff or apply...

traditionalOverrides.DataIntegration.common.recoveryStorageUn: 無法建立本次本機執行保護（恢復儲存不可用、內容損壞、已達安全上限，或已有其他 RunId）；本次未啟動執行或提交對賬。請保留目前頁面並聯絡管理員。
traditionalOverrides.DataIntegration.common.recoveryCleanupUn: 本機執行保護清理失敗
伺服器端結果已經明確，但本機執行保護未能清理；系統已保留原 RunId，並將在恢復可用後進行唯讀核驗。請重新整理頁面；若持續出現，請聯絡管理員。
